subject: Request: Special rate authorization for HelixHealth — multimodel rollout delay
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Special rate authorization for HelixHealth — multimodel rollout delay

Team,

Quick summary: HelixHealth (enterprise, HLX-2028-07) reported that their multimodel integration that was scheduled for March slipped to late May due to their internal validation. Because they were dependent on our new multimodel routing, they routed through a heavier hosted path and incurred ~3x token spend in April. They’re asking for a one-time commercial accommodation to keep renewal on track.

Attached is a two-sheet summary (Helix_impact_summary.xlsx) with usage delta, expected cost uplift, and customer timeline. Key ask from CS: a one-time credit equal to 25% of April-May billed usage or a fixed $45k credit — customer prefers percentage.

Asking for your guidance on approval path:
- Finance: revenue impact + precedent (Marcus)
- Sales: acceptability to preserve renewal & reference (Laura)
- Product/Ops: is there anything we can do on our side to mitigate similar spikes (Stephanie)

I recommend we propose the 25% credit for two billing periods plus a technical mitigation plan (KV cache tweaks + temporary rate limit guard) and require a small extension on committed ARR to offset. I can draft the external note to send if we agree.

Camila
Senior Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helix_impact_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Special rate authorization for HelixHealth — multimodel rollout delay

Camila — thanks for the context and the workbook. Quick thoughts after a look:
- If we do 25% for two months the revenue hit is roughly $38k (per the sheet) and the ARR risk avoided looks like ~ $120k over 12 months if they churn.
- Precedent: we’ve given similar one-offs but usually as fixed-dollar makegoods tied to a remediation plan.
- Legal check: need standard T&Cs language and approval from Legal for a concession over $30k.

Can we get finance to mark this as a one-time contra with a required customer acceptance form? If Legal approves, I’d be comfortable recommending the 25% credit with a clause: Helix must accept the updated onboarding checklist and commit to the revised rollout milestones.

Also tagging Product/Ops — is the temporary mitigation you suggested low lift? If so we can offer it as a condition to the credit.

Marcus
Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Special rate authorization for HelixHealth — multimodel rollout delay

Appreciate the analysis. From a GTM standpoint, Helix is strategic in healthcare verticals and we should be conservative about letting price friction derail renewal. I support the 25% credit for two cycles, conditional on:
- Ops mitigation implemented within 2 weeks (ProdRollbackPlan.pdf attached)
- Customer signs the mutual action plan (MAP) with the revised launch date and success metrics
- We secure a reference commit or an expanded pilot for a different BU (they’re open)

If Legal needs tighter language, we’ll take it, but please push to get aditya’s sign-off on the final approval since this is >$30k. I’ll draft a short commercial note to send once Finance and Legal confirm.

— Laura
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ProdRollbackPlan.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Apr 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Special rate authorization for HelixHealth — multimodel rollout delay

Thanks — reviewed with Product and CS this morning. Short answers:
- Mitigation: we can enable temporary prefix caching + a routing guard to reduce token amplification within 48 hours; low infra effort. Will require a short config flag and a monitored rollback window.
- Legal: flagged for review, needs exec approval for concession > $30k.
- Finance: Marcus, please confirm contra booking code.

Proposal for exec sign-off:
1) Approve 25% credit for April + May (applied as a billing credit against 2028-04/2028-05 invoices)
2) Condition: implement mitigation (ops) within 48 hours and mutual action plan signed within 7 days
3) Condition: customer commits to a 9-month renewal extension OR an expanded pilot (documented in HubSpot)

Camila — please prepare the customer-facing note and Legal acceptance form. I’ll attach the approval-signature.png once aditya OKs. Aditya — can you please confirm?

Stephanie
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
